title_en: Price flat, balance down? Finish the last level with costs in mind
title_zh: 没涨没跌也扣钱？带着成本完成最后一关
goal_en: Know the direction and the base of funding fees, run a full futures risk check, and be able to choose not to trade.
goal_zh: 知道资金费率的方向与计费基数，综合核对合约风险并能选择不交易。

shots.visual_en: The price line is almost flat, yet Sam finds the futures balance has gone down.
shots.visual_zh: 价格线近乎水平，小白却发现合约余额变少。

lines.en: The price barely moved and I didn't close. Why is my balance lower?
lines.zh: 价格没怎么动，我也没平仓，为什么余额少了？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E24' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第24集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Price flat, balance down? Finish the last level with costs in mind
onscreen_text_zh: 没涨没跌也扣钱？带着成本完成最后一关

shots.visual_en: The bill splits into trading fees and funding fees; two-way payment arrows run between longs and shorts.
shots.visual_zh: 账单分成交易费和资金费用；多空双方间出现双向支付箭头。

lines.en: Besides trading fees, perpetual contracts usually have a funding mechanism. When the rate is positive, longs usually pay shorts. When it's negative, it flips. It's not a fixed interest everyone pays to the exchange.
lines.zh: 永续合约除了交易费用，通常还有资金费用机制。正费率时，通常多头支付给空头；负费率时方向相反。它不是每个人都支付给交易所的一笔固定利息。

shots.visual_en: Teaching settlement: position value 1,000, period rate 0.01%, result 0.10; the 100 margin is crossed out as the base.
shots.visual_zh: 教学结算时仓位价值1000、当期费率0.01%，算出0.10；100保证金划掉。

lines.en: Say the position value at settlement is 1,000 and the rate is 0.01%. This fee is 0.10. It's based on the position value, not your first 100 of margin.
lines.zh: 假设结算时仓位价值是一千，费率是百分之零点零一，本次费用是零点一；按仓位价值计算，不是按最初的一百保证金算。

onscreen_text_en: Teaching assumption · not a live price or real platform rate
onscreen_text_zh: 基数：仓位价值，不是 100 保证金
教学假设 · 非实时行情，非平台真实费率

shots.visual_en: Settlement countdown and current rate are both updatable fields; an '8 hours' tag reads 'example for some products only'.
shots.visual_zh: 结算倒计时和当前费率都是可更新字段，八小时标签旁写“仅某些产品示例”。

lines.en: The interval and the rate can change by pair, platform and market. Don't remember it as 'every contract, every eight hours, forever'. And don't treat receiving funding as risk-free income.
lines.zh: 结算间隔和费率可能因交易对、平台和市场情况变化。不能记成所有合约永远每八小时扣一次，也不能把收资金费当作无风险收益。

shots.visual_en: Final practice card asks for: contract type, margin mode, notional size, margin, auto-add setting, stop-loss and costs.
shots.visual_zh: 最终练习卡要求选择合约类型、模式、名义仓位、保证金、追加设置、止损与费用。

lines.en: The last level is practice only. First explain what you're trading and which direction. Then check the mode, size, margin, auto-add, exit plan and costs. If you don't understand one item, pause. Don't guess your way through the buttons.
lines.zh: 最后一关只做模拟。先解释交易对象和方向，再核对模式、仓位、保证金、自动追加、退出计划与成本。看不懂一项，就暂停，不靠猜按钮完成。

shots.visual_en: The completion page has only 'Review' and 'Save learning record'; Sam switches off a real 'open position' button.
shots.visual_zh: 结课页只有“复习”和“保存学习记录”；小白主动把真实开仓按钮关闭。

lines.en: I know how to do it, and I know this risk isn't right for me. So I won't.
lines.zh: 我知道怎么操作，也知道这笔风险不适合我，所以不做。

lines.en: That's a passing result too. Finishing the course doesn't mean you can make money. Understand first, then act.
lines.zh: 这也是合格的学习结果。完成课程，不代表盈利能力；先看懂，再动手。

shots.visual_en: Conversion card (6 s): clean NexuAlpha card slides in from the right; text only (exchange name as text, no exchange logo artwork, no fake clickable button, no QR to an unverified page). Disclosure line sits on the card itself, at least 70% of subtitle size. No reward amount, no percentage, no date. Nexubo beside the card, thumbs-up, antenna green. For restricted locales swap to the restricted_variant (official-site link only).
shots.visual_zh: 转化卡（6秒）：NexuAlpha卡片从右侧滑入；只用文字写交易所名称，不放交易所标志图，不画假按钮，不放未核验二维码。披露语印在卡片上，字号不小于字幕的70%。不出现奖励金额、百分比和日期。小纳在旁点赞，天线绿灯。受限语种改用 restricted_variant（只给官网链接）。

lines.en: Whatever you trade, fees are a cost that adds up. Compare fees on NexuAlpha, and register through an official partner link with our code to get part of your fees back. Lower cost, same risk.
lines.zh: 无论交易什么，手续费都会累积成成本。在 NexuAlpha 对比各家费用，通过官方合作链接注册并填写我们的邀请码，可返还部分手续费。成本降低，风险不变。

onscreen_text_en: Partner link · the exchange pays our commission
Availability depends on your country or region
onscreen_text_zh: 在 NexuAlpha 对比交易所
合作推广链接 · 佣金由交易所支付
是否可用取决于你所在的国家或地区

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): course map of all 24 episodes; Sam taps one 'hardest' episode, it glows. Nexubo antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：24集课程地图，小白点亮一集“最难的”。小纳天线蓝灯。

lines.en: You've finished both seasons. Pick the episode that felt hardest, and rewatch it before you ever trade.
lines.zh: 两季都学完了。挑一集你觉得最难的，在任何真实交易前再看一遍。

onscreen_text_en: You've finished both seasons. Pick the episode that felt hardest, and rewatch it before you ever trade.
onscreen_text_zh: 两季都学完了。挑一集你觉得最难的，在任何真实交易前再看一遍。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

exercise.task_en: Calculate one period's fee of 0.10 and complete the virtual futures order checklist. Real order APIs must not be called.
exercise.task_zh: 计算单期费用0.10，并完成虚拟合约订单核对；不得调用真实下单接口。
exercise.answer_en: Positive rate: longs pay, shorts receive. Fee in this example: 0.10. Pass by getting all key risk questions right, or by clearly choosing not to trade.
exercise.answer_zh: 正费率多付空收；本例费用0.10；风险关键题全部答对或明确选择不交易。

red_lines: Verify rates and intervals from platform rules ｜ 费率、间隔从平台规则核验
Never turn the course finale into a futures sign-up or deposit requirement ｜ 不把模拟结课变成合约开户或充值要求

Conversion card is about fees on any trade (spot included) and comes after Sam's 'I won't'; never mention futures, leverage or 'open position' on the card ｜ 转化卡只讲任何交易的手续费成本（含现货），放在小白“不做”之后；卡上不提合约、杠杆、开仓
Futures examples are USDT-margined linear perpetuals only; never mix in coin-margined, options or delivery formulas ｜ 合约示例限USDT计价线性永续，不混入币本位、期权和交割合约公式

Conversion card: no reward amounts, percentages or dates in the video; disclosure on the card; restricted locales (ru/ar/zh-Hant/ur/uk/vi/ja/ko) get the neutral official-site variant ｜ 转化卡不写奖励金额、百分比、日期；卡片上必须有披露语；受限语种只给官网中性链接
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
